name: Hisense Visual Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hisense Visual Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of display chips and internet operation services in China and internationally. The company also manufactures and sells of computer, communication, and other electronic equipment. It also provides smart display terminals; laser display, commercial display, cloud service, chip business and other new display; and other products. Hisense Visual Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Hisense Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hisense Visual Technology Co., Ltd. in December 2019. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
